_comment: Generated by bin/heimdall-hooks regen -- the ONLY writer of this file. fingerprint = sha256(matcher + "\n" + command). Edit id/description/locked/remote_toggle by hand, never fingerprint. `heimdall-hooks check` fails on drift.

hooks.description: Injects a delegation directive when a prompt looks multi-part (heuristic, ~1ms).
Prints the context-window meter notice from heimdall-ctx-meter.
REFUSES a prompt carrying a pasted credential so the value is never transmitted (heimdall-secret-filter).
Adds the current caveman compression level as additionalContext on every prompt.
Fallback delivery of companion-app inbox messages via heimdall-inbox-deliver prompt: pops immediately at UserPromptSubmit, never waits, no-op when the inbox is empty.

Drops a pending phone `interrupt` request (<repo>/.heimdall/ui/stop-request.json) at UserPromptSubmit via heimdall-phone-control prompt, so a stale stop flag can never end the NEXT turn. A file test runs first, so nothing pending costs no process. Attended sessions only. Not remote_toggle: the phone cannot switch off its own stop path.
git-guard stale-lock clear, commit secret scan, pre-push quality/secret/selfscan/oracle/corpus gates (exit 2 blocks).
Counts Read/Grep/Glob calls for the parallelism grade.
Named-agent notice and the brief-adoption gate that rewrites oversized spawn prompts (heimdall-precheck-agent).
BIFROST stub gate: blocks Write/Edit content matching an unfinished-code shape (exit 2).
Advisory collision pre-warning when a live teammate holds a claim on the file (heimdall-precheck-edit).
BLOCKS Read/Grep/Glob/Bash reads of credential-bearing files before they enter model context.
Deny edits to linter/formatter/typechecker config (anti-evasion; operator override HMD_ALLOW_LINTCONFIG_EDIT=1)

On by default (off: HMD_PHONE_DENY=0, or heimdall-hooks disable phone-deny): holds a risky shell command or outside-the-repo write for up to HMD_PHONE_DENY_WINDOW_S (default 10 s, max 120) so the paired phone can deny it, or stop the turn, over the sealed relay. The phone can only reduce what runs, never approve; no connected companion (a file test on <repo>/.heimdall/app/connect.json skips the hook first), no reply, an unattended session or any error -> does nothing and exits 0 (Claude Code's normal permission flow proceeds).

Mid-turn delivery of companion-app inbox messages before a tool runs, via heimdall-inbox-deliver tool: pops the queue and returns it as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext behind the companion-inbox provenance marker, so a phone message reaches the running turn at its next tool boundary instead of when the turn ends. A file-size test on <repo>/.heimdall/ui/inbox.jsonl runs before anything else, so an empty inbox costs no python and no git. Never consumes for a headless claude -p / SDK session, an hmd sub-session or a subagent's own tool call; never carries a permissionDecision. Every receipt is stamped exactly as the Stop path stamps it.

Honours the phone's `interrupt` before a tool runs, via heimdall-phone-control stop: a stop request younger than 120 s is consumed once (renamed to stop-request.consumed) and answered with {continue:false, stopReason}. A file test on <repo>/.heimdall/ui/stop-request.json runs first, so a tool call with nothing pending costs one shell builtin. Attended sessions only; never blocks on its own failure. Not remote_toggle: the phone cannot switch off its own stop path.
Captures a failed oracle report into the regression corpus after a Bash call.
Logs every edit, marks heimdall-state dirty (arms the pre-push quality gate), autocommits at 5+ changed files.
Background, throttled heimdall-context-sync after a Write/Edit.
Writes a journal entry when a Bash call landed a new git commit.

Mid-turn delivery of companion-app inbox messages after a tool ran, via heimdall-inbox-deliver tool: the same pop, marker, caps and receipts as inbox-deliver-pretool, returned as PostToolUse additionalContext next to the tool result and read on the model's next request. Fires on every tool call, so a file-size test on <repo>/.heimdall/ui/inbox.jsonl runs first and an empty inbox costs no python and no git. Never consumes for a headless claude -p / SDK session, an hmd sub-session or a subagent's own tool call.

Honours the phone's `interrupt` after a tool ran, via heimdall-phone-control stop: the same single-use, 120 s request as phone-control-pretool, so a stop lands the moment a long tool call returns instead of one model reply later. File-test fast path; attended sessions only; never blocks on its own failure. Not remote_toggle.
Autoupdate check, statusline register, selfheal, tracker builds, state init, stack detect, team/presence beat, reap/cleanup advice, checkpoint notice.
Runs heimdall-resume-probe (10s alarm) when a CHECKPOINT.md exists and prints its head.
heimdall-maintain-loop resume-hint.
heimdall-quota-resume resume-hint.
heimdall-dream-notice for the repo.
Starts the presence keeper for this session in the background (paired with presence-keeper-stop).
heimdall-presence connect-prompt.
heimdall-ai-select session-start.
Restarts a claude-mem daemon that is running with a routing/fallback-credential-contaminated env (credential egress fix C-1).
Prints the caveman compression rules into session context.
Advisory: warns about ANTHROPIC_* overrides persisted in a Claude Code settings.json env block (5s alarm).
Advisory: warns when the clone sits on volatile disk holding unpushed work (5s alarm).

Records this session (<repo>/.heimdall/app/session.json, 0600) so every reader of the 5-character session code agrees with the statusline, and -- when gh is signed in -- opens its pair-by-code window in the background (hmd app pair-window): a phone signed in to the same GitHub account that types the code pairs at once, with no number to compare and a notice in the session and on the statusline. Sends the laptop's gh token to the relay (over TLS, on a pipe) about once a minute for as long as the session lives and the window is unclaimed. Skipped when gh is signed out, in an unattended session (claude -p, an hmd sub-session) and under HMD_PAIR_WINDOW=0; disabling it (heimdall-hooks disable pair-window-start) leaves pairing to hmd app connect. Paired with pair-window-stop.
Records a heimdall-metric task outcome for the finished subagent.
Scans the subagent transcript for a 429/rate-limit and marks it for fallback routing.
Metric reminder at main-agent Stop.
Detects a stale present-tense process-status claim in the final message (heimdall-claim-check).
Scans the main transcript for a 429/rate-limit and marks it for fallback routing.
Batch-lint every path edited this session at Stop; records a real lint receipt into heimdall-state

Delivers companion-app inbox messages via heimdall-inbox-deliver stop. With the inbox empty it long-polls when a companion is connected (a live <repo>/.heimdall/app/connect.json; attended sessions only -- never headless claude -p or hmd sub-sessions) after ANY last message, up to 300s (hook timeout 330), or when hmd's last message ended in a question, up to 240s. Either hold ends the moment the session's terminal is read (the operator typing, or a prompt just sent; on macOS only while a keyboard or pointer was used in the last 10s, so a terminal focus report with nobody there does not count), because a prompt typed behind a running Stop hook queues until it exits; whatever is queued then rides that prompt via the UserPromptSubmit hook. HMD_INBOX_TTY=off disables that release and a path pins the terminal; HMD_INBOX_PRESENCE_CMD replaces the keyboard-idle source; with no terminal or no ps the hold runs unchanged. HMD_INBOX_GATED=1 keeps the question wait off (near-instant return) unless <repo>/.heimdall/ui/inbox.wait exists, so opting in to the 240s question wait requires that marker file; a connected companion is the implicit opt-in for the 300s wait. Export HMD_INBOX_WAIT_S=0 to never hold a turn.
Stops this session's presence keeper (disabling it with presence-keeper-start enabled leaks a keeper process).

Foreground, each alarm-bounded (10s): checkpoint write, then autocommit — the never-lose contract; both must land before the hook returns (a checkpoint written but not committed is lost on `git worktree remove`). Background: parallelism grade, verify-edits --quick, cleanup, reel, summary-card, context-sync; then the farewell.

Forgets this session (removes <repo>/.heimdall/app/session.json when it names this session) and closes its pair-by-code window (hmd app pair-window --stop), which revokes its relay session. Disabling it with pair-window-start enabled leaves a window to end with the Claude process instead (its supervisor exits when that is gone).
Auto-checkpoint .planning/CHECKPOINT.md before compaction rewrites context (fail-open, stdout suppressed)
